title: The Coming Battles Over American Foreign Policy
gist: Podcast episode description (not a transcript): after the Democrats' sweeping midterm victory, Dan Kurtz-Phelan hosts Kori Schake (AEI) and Thomas Wright (Brookings) on the coming intra- and inter-party fights over post-Trump US foreign policy — China, the Middle East, AI, defense spending — amid an unresolved Iran war and Trump's lame-duck period.

insights.claim: The Democrats' sweeping victory in the November 2026 midterm elections marks a new phase for Donald Trump's foreign policy and kicks off an intensive debate in both parties about US foreign policy beyond Trump.
insights.speaker: Kori Schake
insights.so_what: Divided government from 2027 could constrain executive foreign/trade policy — watch congressional oversight and appropriations.
insights.quote: The Democrats’ sweeping victory in the midterm elections this week marks not only the start of a new phase for Donald Trump’s foreign policy.
